descriptor.text: and a usable transmission behave as one road-going machine was a different problem entirely.
descriptor.visual: An animated cutaway diagram showing an engine, chassis, and transmission interlocking together into a single cohesive road-going machine.

proposal.summary: The diagram shows an engine suspended above the chassis, but bringing it into the assembled machine requires translation and attachment that the available motion model cannot represent.

targets.evidence: The gray engine is visibly separate from the frame, with a downward arrow beneath it.
targets.why: The cue describes the engine, chassis, and transmission interlocking as one machine; depicting that assembly requires moving and attaching the engine.

needsArtwork.reason: The engine must translate into the chassis and connect to it; rigid polygon pivot motion cannot perform that assembly while preserving correct overlap and contact.
